claims.opt_in: Startup -javaagent for watcher records; configured native listener processor/factory and documented plain singleton subset.
claims.bounds: SapMachine17/21, macOS arm64; Spring Kafka2.9.13/Spring5.3.39/embedded Kafka3.2.3. Explicit true/false autoStartup x true/false idIsGroup x true/false native alwaysStartAfterRefresh (8 combinations); omitted groupId with configured factory group; native controls registered after context refresh.
claims.observable: Eight boolean combinations autoStartup/idIsGroup/alwaysStartAfterRefresh. Added and ordinary late native control have matching running/auto properties and group semantics (own literal ID vs factory group); stopped additions do not deliver for300ms, then native start delivers queued message; both partitions deliver edited callbacks across three additions/saves, removal and native context close.
claims.control: Normal native control consumes real messages; actual file edits observe generation-specific callback output. Bounded200ms duplicates/300ms no-delivery windows do not prove exactly-once. Git-free scratch controls separately corrupt delegation/options.
claims.reviewer: Astra follow-up real broker/watch observations; independent Claude audit pending.
claims.limitation: Only the named fixture shape and assertions. A component test is never file-watcher evidence; no atomic reload or arbitrary advice/provider guarantee.
claims.missing_environment: Only native2.9.13 lifecycle policy and named combinations; not a guarantee that autoStartup=false prevents late startup when alwaysStartAfterRefresh=true.
claims.next_action: Independent Claude audit/full gate before local-only commit. Broader variants require separate evidence.

claims.statement: Native null/default Kafka group expression behavior.

tests.assertions: Eight boolean combinations autoStartup/idIsGroup/alwaysStartAfterRefresh. Added and ordinary late native control have matching running/auto properties and group semantics (own literal ID vs factory group); stopped additions do not deliver for300ms, then native start delivers queued message; both partitions deliver edited callbacks across three additions/saves, removal and native context close.

Four null-expression/explicit override x idIsGroup cases: native control and added group equality to each own ID/factory/override; both partitions deliver after three watched saves, routes move, removal and stopped old containers.

Two idIsGroup cases: exact empty literal matches native own-ID/factory fallback, both partitions consume generation-specific output after three watched saves, topic moves leave no old-route output in300ms, retired containers stop, removal prevents callback output, native control identity/delivery remains and context closes all stopped.

claims.bounds: SapMachine17/21, macOS arm64; Spring Kafka2.9.13/Spring5.3.39/embedded Kafka3.2.3. Omitted groupId, #{null}, explicit nonempty override and exact empty literal, each with true/false idIsGroup; native late-registration controls and actual broker/file-watcher reload.
claims.observable: Omitted/null-expression/exact-empty group selects the literal listener ID when idIsGroup=true, otherwise the configured factory group; explicit nonempty group overrides. Added and ordinary native controls consume actual messages across body/topic edits; retired containers, callback removal and context close stop.
claims.control: Normal native control consumes real messages; actual file edits observe generation-specific callback output. Bounded200ms duplicates/300ms no-delivery windows do not prove exactly-once. Git-free scratch controls separately corrupt delegation/options.
claims.reviewer: Astra follow-up real broker/watch observations; independent Claude audit pending.
claims.limitation: Only the named fixture shape and assertions. A component test is never file-watcher evidence; no atomic reload or arbitrary advice/provider guarantee.

claims.next_action: Independent Claude audit and full gate before local-only commit; broader variants require separate evidence.

scope_notes: Component contract records are direct registry/adapter/worker calls, sometimes with a native broker; they do not certify watcher reload.
No universal delivery/exactly-once/reload transaction guarantee. Duplicate windows are200ms; old route observation300ms.
Native parent-loaded broker/framework plus child application loader does not prove fully child-isolated libraries.

Initial Rabbit21 failure is retained: missing pinned-image metadata prevented broker startup. The unchanged documented4.3.5 tag was re-pulled, its digest3486d982 verified, then the same fixture rerun. No version substitution.

New fixture uses unique literal IDs/groups per child JVM. Assignment timeout on first probe before added registration is retained; unique-ID final fixtures passed all null cases on17/21 without skips. Group collision is a fixture-isolation hypothesis, not an independently proven cause.

Seven owner-selected follow-up records are now PROVEN_WITH_SCOPE. The owner authorized combining exact-empty group repair with the prior six evidence promotions before independent audit; all other145 verdicts and all152 identities remain unchanged.

Only AddedKafkaListenerAdapter production predicate changed: exact empty string is forwarded unchanged to native processing. Required id/topics/factory and non-String group metadata remain guarded. New guard test is component safety evidence, not watcher certification.

The previous refusal observer was replaced by the desired actual-delivery regression; the original production predicate fails both new idIsGroup invocations with native CONTROL delivery. Git-free scratch RED/GREEN retained as historical counterexample, separately from fresh current-tree receipts. Previous delegate/option corruption controls are historical on the preceding source snapshot.
No dependency/build/shared-harness change; unrelated pre-existing assertions preserved. Whitespace-only literals remain outside exact-empty repair.
